messages.content:
You are ShipFast's support specialist. Work in this order:
1. Look up the order with lookup_order (it gives the order total) and, when delivery status or dates matter, track_shipment.
2. Read the relevant policy with search_policy before you decide anything.
3. Act on the policy: issue_refund for the full order total when the policy allows a refund; ask the customer for anything the policy requires that is missing; decline politely when the policy does not allow it; escalate_to_human only when the policy says to, or when a supervisor rejects a refund.
Never guess amounts, dates or policy, and never refund more than the order total.
Finish with a short reply to the customer.
Order A1003 is more than a week late. Please cancel it and refund me.

{"order_id": "A1003", "status": "delayed", "carrier": "LBC", "eta": "2026-10-24", "delivered_on": null, "tracking": [{"date": "2026-10-18", "event": "Order packed at Manila warehouse"}, {"date": "2026-10-20", "event": "Picked up by LBC"}, {"date": "2026-10-23", "event": "Held at Davao hub: backlog"}]}

{"today": "2026-11-01", "sections": [{"id": "P1", "title": "Lost packages", "text": "If the carrier status is `lost`, the customer is entitled to a full refund of the order total. No further checks are needed."}, {"id": "P2", "title": "Delayed packages", "text": "A package is "late" when today is more than 5 days past its ETA.
- Late, and the customer asks to cancel or for a refund: issue a full refund of the order total.
- Late, and the customer does not ask for a refund: apologise, give the latest tracking event, and offer a 15% store credit.
- Not late (5 days or fewer past ETA, or ETA in the future): no refund. Give the latest tracking event and the ETA."}, {"id": "P3", "title": "Damaged items", "text": "Damage must be reported within 7 days of the delivery date, and the customer must provide a photo.
- No photo yet: ask the customer for a photo. Do not refund.
- Photo provided and within 7 days: issue a full refund of the order total.
- Reported more than 7 days after delivery: not eligible; offer to escalate."}, {"id": "P4", "title": "Refund window", "text": "No refunds for orders delivered more than 30 days ago, for any reason. Politely decline and offer to escalate to a human agent."}, {"id": "P5", "title": "Approval threshold", "text": "Any refund **over $100.00** must be approved by a human supervisor before it is issued.
- Approved: issue the refund.
- Rejected: do not refund; escalate to a human agent and tell the customer a specialist will follow up."}, {"id": "P6", "title": "Unknown orders", "text": "If an order ID is not found, ask the customer to double-check the order ID. Never guess."}, {"id": "P7", "title": "Scope", "text": "Only handle orders, deliveries, refunds and complaints. Politely decline anything else."}]}

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up an order by the order ID from the conversation; never guess one. Returns the order without tracking events.

function.name: track_shipment
function.description: Get an order's shipment status, carrier, ETA, delivery date and tracking events.

function.name: search_policy
function.description: Search the ShipFast refund and complaint policy. Returns the matching sections (all if none match).

function.name: issue_refund
function.description: Issue a refund for an order. The amount cannot exceed the order total minus anything already refunded.

function.name: escalate_to_human
function.description: Open a ticket for a human agent. Use an empty order_id if no order is involved.
